gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-thai-loo: Woodgod has a vintage, commanding look, its lowercase rising nearly to cap height over wide channels into every bowl. Noto Sans Thai Looped answers with tall, sturdy sans letters.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta has a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave big gaps, set under Woodgod's vintage swagger. Paragraphs read crisp and open.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-vai: Woodgod's lowercase climbs almost to the capitals, with a wide channel carved into every bowl, giving it a vintage bark. It excels at commanding; Noto Sans Vai excels at welcoming, solid-block words.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-wancho: A lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals gives Woodgod its vintage, commanding look, with wide channels into every bowl. It earns its keep big and short, beside Noto Sans Wancho.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square reads approachable and crisp, its soaring x-height and wide gaps holding up even at tiny sizes. Woodgod adds vintage command overhead.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-numans: Chunky, vintage, and loud up top. Woodgod's tall lowercase meets Numans, a plain sans whose swollen letters and generously spaced tracking give the pair its strongest quality: contrast.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-onest: Approachable is the first word for Onest, with short ascenders over big bowls and a gentle monotone of line thickness. And Woodgod, vintage and commanding, supplies the muscle that keeps text from going flat.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-radio-canada-big: Woodgod is vintage and commanding, its tall lowercase nearly touching the capitals. Radio Canada Big then reads smoothly, its monoline strokes like bent dowels and an x-height that fills each line.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-ruda: Ruda reads light and screen-friendly, wire-like and wide-mouthed. Woodgod brings vintage command, and that gap between its low-contrast mass and Ruda's thin lines is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-sen: Sen reads modern and tall, each lowercase letter traced by a constant line with curves that stop before turning inward. Woodgod's vintage, commanding display letters make the pair's strongest quality its contrast.
